description: Send a raw request to any ClickUp API path, for endpoints or parameters the typed tools don't cover. Uses the configured token; the host is fixed to the ClickUp API. Example: method=GET, path=/api/v2/team.

path.description: Path starting with /api/v2/ or /api/v3/ (path params already filled in).

query.description: Query parameters. Array values are sent as repeated keys; use 'key[]' as the key for bracket style.

name: clickup_request
